stated_problem.quote: And sometimes on land it's 8 to 10% because like you said, good agents don't want to list a $40 $50,000 property that's going to take 6 months to sell.

idea.name: Builder-first vacant land wholesaling
idea.one_liner: Get spec home builders' buy boxes (price, zip, lot size), then mass-offer 10-20% less to long-held off-market lot owners via mailed contracts, texts and cold calls, and assign the contract to the builder for a ~$8.6K average fee without buying
idea.customer: spec home builders (from D.R. Horton to 1-3 lots/year builders) and land bankers
idea.offer: off-market buildable lots matching the builder's buy box
idea.revenue_model: assignment fee (spread between seller and builder price)

key_quotes.quote: So the first thing, the way we do it with the builder first method is you get the builder's buy box.
So, if a buyer says they're going to pay $100,000, we're just going to mass offer $90,000 to everybody that owns that piece of property.
So, we'd go down to the mailbox and every other day almost, we would have a signed contract that was a deal just in there, never spoke to the seller, nothing.
Go on Zillow and this is the the free way to find your builders is you go on Zillow and Zillow.com free website, everybody.

claims.quote: In that amount of marketing, in a real example, our best month that we ever did was 37 deals and $532,000 in profit, right?
Our biggest year was 2.1 million in assignments, 1.7 in profit.
We've done over 100,000 a month for the last 40 months straight.
But all time on our texting, we have 37 times return on investment.

claims.claim: $1,000 cash referral bonus produced 28-29 deals last year
claims.quote: we'll send you $1,000 in cash as like a joint venture deal with them." So, we did about 28 or 29 deals like that last year just off the referral
So like we we've done over the past four years now, we've done a little over 6 million in profit.

acquisition_channels.details: direct mail: one-page intro letter plus pre-filled contract (REI Print Mail), ~40K mailers/month at peak
mass texting via Smarter Contact/ReplySmart (since stopped to limit liability)
overseas Filipino VA cold callers on BatchDialer/ReadyMode; founders dialling 100/day; 'save my number as Jackson land guy'
handwritten thank-you letter with $1,000 referral bonus; calling neighbours who often pay over market
Zillow to find builders (homes built 2025-26 for sale) and new listings alerts

ideas.delivery: assignable contract with feasibility clause and earnest money due at closing; transaction coordinator, 2 acquisition managers, ~5 VAs; title company handles double contracts; 2-3 week closes

uk_legal_risk.reason: Mass cold texts and cold calls to individual landowners breach PECR (SMS needs consent; calls must screen TPS)

ideas.other_uk_rules: Introducing land to buyers for a fee can be estate agency work under the Estate Agents Act 1979 (redress scheme, HMRC AML supervision); UK GDPR for skip-traced owner data

idea.name: Buyer Bridge: CRM and buyer network for land flippers
idea.one_liner: Purpose-built CRM for land wholesaling combining contracts, title work and a database of ~12K buyers and ~6K buy boxes
idea.offer: land flipping CRM with buyer buy-box network

key_quotes.quote: But it has it's a full-blown CRM for like it was built like nothing in the past was ever built for land flipping.
And then it has uh 12,000 buyers right now.

idea.name: Luxury teardown land deals
idea.one_liner: Buy small old homes on prime low-supply lots purely for land value to bulldoze and build $10-20M luxury homes

key_quotes.quote: Um, the one thing I will do is, uh, which is luxury, which is something we've gone into a little more recently, is tear downs, right?
So when you buy the the house from that person that might have paid hundred grand for it, you can give them $3 million because you're just going to bulldoze the house and build a luxury home, right?
